static void make_speed_xy_back(State* ewk, State* mwk, ProjectileEntity* projectile);

const s16 projectile_process_07_dm_vital[4];
const ProjectileEntity projectile_data[243];
const s16 tcct[36];
void (*const projectile_process[17])();
const s16 kage_tbl[6][4];
const s16 homing_empos_hos[1][20][2];
const s16 enemy_pos_hos[1][20][2];
const s16 X_F_L_A_T_pos_hos[1][20][2];

void effect_13_move(State_Other* ewk) {
    ProjectileEntity* projectile = (ProjectileEntity*)ewk->wu.my_effadrs;
    PlayerEntity* mwk;
    PlayerEntity* emwk;

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[0]) {
    case 0:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
        ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet = 14;
        ewk->wu.charset_id = 11;
        set_char_base_data(&ewk->wu);
        ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag = 0;
        ewk->wu.work_id = projectile->owner_work_id;
        ewk->wu.dir_timer = projectile->life_time;
        ewk->wu.disp_flag = projectile->display_type;
        ewk->wu.blink_timing = ewk->master_id;
        ewk->wu.attack_art_type = projectile->kind_of_arts;
        ewk->wu.vital_new = projectile->base_damage;
        ewk->wu.damage_vitality = 0;
        ewk->wu.original_vitality = projectile->movement_type;
        ewk->wu.shell_vs_refrect = projectile->vs_reflect;
        ewk->wu.charset_id = projectile->projectile_type;

        if (ewk->master_id) {
            if (projectile->color_2p == 0) {
                ewk->wu.my_col_code = ewk->wu.old_routine_no[7];
            } else {
                ewk->wu.my_col_code = tcct[projectile->color_2p];
            }
        } else if (projectile->color_1p == 0) {
            ewk->wu.my_col_code = ewk->wu.old_routine_no[7];
        } else {
            ewk->wu.my_col_code = tcct[projectile->color_1p];
        }

        if (projectile->shadow_index) {
            ewk->wu.shadow_flag = 1;
            ewk->wu.shadow_x = kage_tbl[projectile->shadow_index][0];
            ewk->wu.shadow_y = kage_tbl[projectile->shadow_index][1];
            ewk->wu.shadow_prio = kage_tbl[projectile->shadow_index][2];
            ewk->wu.shadow_char = kage_tbl[projectile->shadow_index][3];
        } else {
            ewk->wu.shadow_flag = 0;
        }

        if (projectile->projectile_type == 2) {
            set_tengu_init_pos(&ewk->wu, (State*)ewk->my_master);
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
            ewk->wu.dir_old = ((PlayerEntity*)ewk->my_master)->sa->super_art_id;
            set_char_move_init2(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->char_index, random_16() & 7, 0);
        } else if (projectile->projectile_type == 0xF) {
            mwk = (PlayerEntity*)ewk->my_master;

            if (projectile->custom_data_1) {
                ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = mwk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp;
                ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp = mwk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp ? mwk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp : -0x80000;
                ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = mwk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp;
                ewk->wu.mvxy.d[1].sp = mwk->wu.mvxy.d[1].sp;
                ewk->wu.mvxy.physics_curve_type[1] = 0;
            } else {
                emwk = (PlayerEntity*)mwk->wu.target_adrs;
                ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos = projectile->pushbox_x;
                ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos += emwk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos;
                ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos += X_F_L_A_T_pos_hos[0][emwk->player_number][0];
                ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = projectile->pushbox_y;
                ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos += emwk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos;
                ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos += X_F_L_A_T_pos_hos[0][emwk->player_number][1];
                ewk->wu.facing_flag = ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos > emwk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos ? 0 : 1;
                setup_mvxy_data(&ewk->wu, projectile->custom_data_0);
            }

            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->char_index);
        } else {
            if (ewk->wu.facing_flag) {
                ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos -= projectile->pushbox_x;
            } else {
                ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos += projectile->pushbox_x;
            }

            ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos += projectile->pushbox_y;
            ewk->wu.position_z = ewk->wu.my_priority;

            if (projectile->projectile_type == 7) {
                ewk->wu.position_z += 2;
            }

            setup_mvxy_data(&ewk->wu, projectile->custom_data_0);
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->char_index);
        }

        if (projectile->projectile_type == 11) {
            ewk->wu.next_z = 71;
            ewk->wu.mirror_flag = 1;
            ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.x = 127;
            ewk->wu.mirror_scale.size.y = 127;
        }

        if (projectile->projectile_type == 10) {
            ewk->wu.facing_flag = ((State*)ewk->my_master)->active_move;
        }

        tama_display(&ewk->wu);
        effect_00_init(&ewk->wu);
        break;

    case 1:
        if (ewk->wu.death_timer == 1 || g_state.Suicide[6] != 0) {
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
            break;
        }

        if (ewk->wu.hit_stop < 0) {
            ewk->wu.hit_stop = -ewk->wu.hit_stop;
        }

        if (g_state.execute_flag == 0 && g_state.Game_pause == 0) {
            projectile_process[projectile->projectile_type](ewk, projectile);
        }

        tama_display(&ewk->wu);

        if (ewk->wu.floor) {
            ewk->wu.attack_type |= 0x20;
            ewk->wu.attack_art_type = 0x80;
        }

        hit_push_request(&ewk->wu);
        break;

    case 2:
        erase_my_shell_ix((State*)ewk->my_master, ewk->wu.myself);
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 3;
        break;

    default:
        all_cgps_put_back(&ewk->wu);
        Release_Effect(&ewk->wu);
        break;
    }
}

static void tama_display(State* wk) {
    set_quake((PlayerEntity*)wk);
    wk->position_x = wk->xyz[0].disp.pos + wk->next_x;
    wk->position_y = wk->xyz[1].disp.pos;
    sort_push_request(wk);
}

s32 screen_x_range_check(State* wk) {
    s16 scpx = get_center_position();
    s16 scpxr = scpx + 256;
    s16 scpxl = scpx - 256;

    scpx = wk->xyz[0].disp.pos;

    if (scpxl < 0) {
        scpxr -= scpxl;
        scpx -= scpxl;
        scpxl = 0;
    }

    if (scpx > scpxr || scpx < scpxl) {
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}

static s32 screen_range_check(State* wk) {
    s16 scpx = get_center_position();
    s16 scpxr = scpx + 256;
    s16 scpxl = scpx - 256;
    s16 scpy;
    s16 scpyu;

    scpx = wk->xyz[0].disp.pos;

    if (scpxl < 0) {
        scpxr -= scpxl;
        scpx -= scpxl;
        scpxl = 0;
    }

    if (scpx > scpxr || scpx < scpxl) {
        return 1;
    }

    scpy = get_height_position();
    scpyu = scpy + 288;
    scpy = wk->xyz[1].disp.pos;

    if (scpy > scpyu) {
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}

static s32 tama15_screen_check(State* wk) {
    s16 scpx = get_center_position();
    s16 scpxr = scpx + 512;
    s16 scpxl = scpx - 512;
    s16 scpy;
    s16 scpyu;
    s16 scpyd;

    scpx = wk->xyz[0].disp.pos;

    if (scpxl < 0) {
        scpxr -= scpxl;
        scpx -= scpxl;
        scpxl = 0;
    }

    if (scpx > scpxr || scpx < scpxl) {
        return 1;
    }

    scpy = get_height_position();
    scpyu = scpy + 512;
    scpyd = scpy - 288;
    scpy = wk->xyz[1].disp.pos;

    if (scpyd < 0) {
        scpyu -= scpyd;
        scpy -= scpyd;
        scpyd = 0;
    }

    if (scpy > scpyu || scpy < scpyd) {
        return 1;
    }

    return 0;
}

static void set_tengu_init_pos(State* ewk, State* mwk) {
    s16 scp = get_center_position();

    if (mwk->facing_flag) {
        scp -= 320;
    } else {
        scp += 320;
    }

    ewk->xyz[0].disp.pos = scp;
    ewk->xyz[1].disp.pos = ewk->direction;
}

static void projectile_process_00000(State_Other* ewk, ProjectileEntity* projectile) {
    if (ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 1;
    }

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        if (ewk->wu.hit_stop) {
            if (ewk->wu.hit_stop == 1) {
                ewk->wu.hit_stop = 0;
                add_mvxy_speed_exp(&ewk->wu, 2);
            } else {
                ewk->wu.hit_stop--;
                break;
            }
        } else {
            add_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
        }

        cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
        char_move(&ewk->wu);

        if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_normal);
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
            break;
        }

        if ((ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos + ewk->wu.cg_jphos) <= 0) {
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[1].sp = 0;
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_expire);
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 1;
            ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = -ewk->wu.cg_jphos;
            break;
        }

        if (--ewk->wu.dir_timer >= 0 && screen_range_check(&ewk->wu) == 0) {
            break;
        }

        ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp /= 4;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp /= 4;
        set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_normal);
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
        break;

    case 1:
        ewk->wu.vital_new -= ewk->wu.damage_vitality;
        ewk->wu.damage_vitality = 0;

        if (ewk->wu.vital_new < 0x100) {
            if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player) {
                if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player & 0xF0) {
                    set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_defended);
                } else {
                    set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_hit);
                }
            } else {
                set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_expire);
            }

            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 1;
            ewk->wu.shadow_flag = 0;
            ewk->wu.hit_stop = 0;
        } else {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;

            if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player) {
                if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player & 0xF0) {
                    effect_96_init(&ewk->wu, projectile->anim_defended, ewk->wu.disp_flag, ewk->wu.hit_stop);
                } else {
                    effect_96_init(&ewk->wu, projectile->anim_hit, ewk->wu.disp_flag, ewk->wu.hit_stop);
                }
            } else {
                effect_96_init(&ewk->wu, projectile->anim_expire, ewk->wu.disp_flag, ewk->wu.hit_stop);
            }

            if (ewk->damage_reflect) {
                ewk->master_id = (ewk->master_id + 1) & 1;
                ewk->wu.facing_flag = (ewk->wu.facing_flag + 1) & 1;
                ewk->damage_reflect = 0;
            }
        }

        ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag = 0;
        ewk->wu.hit_quake = 0;
        break;

    case 2:
        switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[2]) {
        case 0:
            add_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
            cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
            /* fallthrough */

        case 1:
            char_move(&ewk->wu);

            if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
                ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
                ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
            }

            break;
        }

        break;
    }
}

static void projectile_process_01000(State_Other* ewk, ProjectileEntity* projectile) {
    if (ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 1;
    }

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        if (ewk->wu.hit_stop) {
            ewk->wu.hit_stop--;
            break;
        }

        char_move(&ewk->wu);

        if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_normal);
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
            break;
        }

        if (screen_range_check(&ewk->wu)) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player) {
            if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player & 0xF0) {
                set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_defended);
            } else {
                set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_hit);
            }
        } else {
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_expire);
        }

        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
        ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag = 0;
        ewk->wu.hit_quake = 0;
        break;

    case 2:
        char_move(&ewk->wu);

        if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
        }

        break;
    }
}

static void projectile_process_02000(State_Other* ewk, ProjectileEntity* projectile) {
    PlayerEntity* mwk = (PlayerEntity*)ewk->my_master;

    if (ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 1;
    }

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        if (ewk->wu.hit_stop) {
            ewk->wu.hit_stop--;
            break;
        }

        char_move(&ewk->wu);

        switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[2]) {
        case 0:
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 1;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
            ewk->wu.dir_timer = projectile->custom_data_0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[1].sp = -0x7000;
            cal_initial_speed(&ewk->wu,
                              ewk->wu.dir_timer,
                              mwk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos + ewk->wu.old_pos[0],
                              mwk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos + ewk->wu.old_pos[1]);
            break;

        case 1:
            add_mvxy_speed_no_use_rl(&ewk->wu);
            cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);

            if (check_tengu_attack(&ewk->wu, &mwk->wu, projectile) == 0 && --ewk->wu.dir_timer < 0) {
                ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 2;
            }

            break;

        case 2:
            ewk->wu.position_z = mwk->wu.position_z + ewk->wu.old_pos[2];

            if (mwk->sa->can_activate != -1 || ewk->wu.dir_old != mwk->sa->super_art_id) {
                ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
                ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
                ewk->wu.anim_hurtbox_index = 0;
                make_speed_xy_back(&ewk->wu, &mwk->wu, projectile);
                break;
            }

            if (check_tengu_attack(&ewk->wu, &mwk->wu, projectile)) {
                break;
            }

            set_tengu_my_home(&ewk->wu, &mwk->wu);

            if (ewk->wu.dir_step > 8) {
                ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 1;
                ewk->wu.dir_timer = 8;
                cal_all_speed_data(&ewk->wu, ewk->wu.dir_timer, ewk->wu.damage_calc_multiplier, ewk->wu.damage_calc_divider, 2, 2);
            }

            break;

        case 3:
            add_mvxy_speed_no_use_rl(&ewk->wu);
            cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);

            if (--ewk->wu.dir_timer < 0) {
                ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 4;
                ewk->wu.att_hit_ok = 0;
                ewk->wu.dir_timer = projectile->pushbox_x;
                set_tengu_my_home(&ewk->wu, &mwk->wu);
                cal_all_speed_data(&ewk->wu, ewk->wu.dir_timer, ewk->wu.damage_calc_multiplier, ewk->wu.damage_calc_divider, 2, 2);
            }

            break;

        case 4:
            add_mvxy_speed_no_use_rl(&ewk->wu);
            cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
            ewk->wu.anim_hurtbox_index = 0;

            if (--ewk->wu.dir_timer < 0) {
                ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 2;
            }

            break;

        case 5:
            set_tengu_my_home(&ewk->wu, &mwk->wu);
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 4;
            ewk->wu.anim_hurtbox_index = 0;
            ewk->wu.dir_timer = projectile->pushbox_y;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[1].sp = -0x4000;
            cal_initial_speed(&ewk->wu, ewk->wu.dir_timer, ewk->wu.damage_calc_multiplier, ewk->wu.damage_calc_divider);
            break;
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 5;
        ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag = 0;
        ewk->wu.anim_hurtbox_index = 0;
        set_hit_stop_hit_quake(&ewk->wu);
        break;

    case 2:
        add_mvxy_speed_no_use_rl(&ewk->wu);
        cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);

        if (--ewk->wu.dir_timer < 0) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
        }

        ewk->wu.anim_hurtbox_index = 0;
        break;
    }
}
static void set_tengu_my_home(State* ewk, State* mwk) {
    if (mwk->pat_status < 32) {
        ewk->damage_calc_multiplier = mwk->xyz[0].disp.pos + ewk->old_pos[0];
        ewk->damage_calc_divider = mwk->xyz[1].disp.pos + ewk->old_pos[1];
    } else {
        ewk->damage_calc_multiplier = mwk->xyz[0].disp.pos + ewk->screen_move_x;
        ewk->damage_calc_divider = mwk->xyz[1].disp.pos + ewk->screen_move_y;
    }

    ewk->dir_step = cal_move_quantity2(ewk->xyz[0].disp.pos, ewk->xyz[1].disp.pos, ewk->damage_calc_multiplier, ewk->damage_calc_divider);
}

static s32 check_tengu_attack(State* ewk, State* mwk, ProjectileEntity* projectile) {
    if (mwk->cg_ja.attack_box_index == 0) {
        return 0;
    }

    ewk->routine_no[2] = 3;
    ewk->att_hit_ok = 1;
    ewk->facing_flag = mwk->facing_flag;
    ewk->dir_timer = projectile->life_time;
    grade_add_att_renew((State_Other*)ewk);

    if (mwk->xyz[1].disp.pos > 0) {
        make_speed_xy_att(ewk, mwk, ewk->dir_timer, 2, 0);
    } else {
        make_speed_xy_att(ewk, mwk, ewk->dir_timer, 0, 2);
    }

    return 1;
}

static void make_speed_xy_att(State* ewk, State* mwk, s16 tm, u8 xsw, u8 ysw) {
    s16 ax;
    s16 ay;

    get_target_att_position(mwk, &ax, &ay);
    cal_all_speed_data(ewk, tm, ax, ay, xsw, ysw);
}

static void make_speed_xy_back(State* ewk, State* mwk, ProjectileEntity* projectile) {
    s16 bx;
    s16 by;

    ewk->damage_calc_multiplier = ewk->xyz[0].disp.pos;
    ewk->damage_calc_divider = ewk->xyz[1].disp.pos;
    ewk->mvxy.d[0].sp = 0;
    ewk->mvxy.d[1].sp = -0x7000;
    ewk->dir_timer = projectile->custom_data_1;
    set_tengu_init_pos(ewk, mwk);
    bx = ewk->xyz[0].disp.pos;
    by = ewk->xyz[1].disp.pos;
    ewk->xyz[0].disp.pos = ewk->damage_calc_multiplier;
    ewk->xyz[1].disp.pos = ewk->damage_calc_divider;
    cal_initial_speed(ewk, ewk->dir_timer, bx, by);
}

static void projectile_process_03000(State_Other* ewk, ProjectileEntity* projectile) {
    if (ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 1;
    }

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        if (ewk->wu.hit_stop) {
            ewk->wu.hit_stop--;
            break;
        }

        add_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
        cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
        char_move(&ewk->wu);

        if ((ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos + ewk->wu.cg_jphos) <= 0) {
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[1].sp = 0;
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_normal);
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 1;
            ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = -ewk->wu.cg_jphos;
            break;
        }

        if (--ewk->wu.dir_timer >= 0 && !screen_range_check(&ewk->wu)) {
            break;
        }

        ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
        break;

    case 1:
        ewk->wu.vital_new -= ewk->wu.damage_vitality;
        ewk->wu.hit_stop = 0;
        ewk->wu.hit_quake = 0;

        if (ewk->wu.vital_new < 0x100) {
            if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player) {
                if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player & 0xF0) {
                    set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_defended);
                } else {
                    set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_hit);
                    ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
                    ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 1;
                    ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = 0;
                    ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp = 0;
                    ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = 0;
                    ewk->wu.mvxy.d[1].sp = 0;
                    ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag = 0;
                    ewk->wu.shadow_flag = 0;
                    break;
                }
            } else {
                set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_expire);
            }

            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 2;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = -ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp /= 3;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag = 0;
            ewk->wu.shadow_flag = 0;
            break;
        }

        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
        ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag = 0;
        break;

    case 2:
        switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[2]) {
        case 0:
            add_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
            cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
            /* fallthrough */

        case 1:
            char_move(&ewk->wu);

            if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
                ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
                ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
            }

            break;
        }

        break;
    }
}

static void projectile_process_04000(State_Other* ewk, ProjectileEntity* /* unused */) {
    ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
    ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
}

static void projectile_process_05000(State_Other* ewk, ProjectileEntity* projectile) {
    if (ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 1;
    }

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        if (ewk->wu.routine_no[3] == 0) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[3]++;
            ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = get_height_position() + 256;
        }

        if (ewk->wu.hit_stop) {
            ewk->wu.hit_stop--;
            break;
        }

        add_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
        cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
        char_move(&ewk->wu);

        if ((ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos + ewk->wu.cg_jphos) <= 0) {
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[1].sp = 0;
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_expire);
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 1;
            ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = -ewk->wu.cg_jphos;
            break;
        }

        if (--ewk->wu.dir_timer >= 0 && screen_x_range_check(&ewk->wu) == 0) {
            break;
        }

        ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp /= 4;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp /= 4;
        set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_normal);
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
        break;

    case 1:
        ewk->wu.vital_new -= ewk->wu.damage_vitality;
        ewk->wu.damage_vitality = 0;

        if (ewk->wu.vital_new < 256) {
            if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player) {
                if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player & 0xF0) {
                    set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_defended);
                } else {
                    set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_hit);
                }
            } else {
                set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_expire);
            }

            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 1;
            ewk->wu.shadow_flag = 0;
            ewk->wu.hit_stop = 0;
        } else {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;

            if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player) {
                if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player & 0xF0) {
                    effect_96_init(&ewk->wu, projectile->anim_defended, ewk->wu.disp_flag, ewk->wu.hit_stop);
                } else {
                    effect_96_init(&ewk->wu, projectile->anim_hit, ewk->wu.disp_flag, ewk->wu.hit_stop);
                }
            } else {
                effect_96_init(&ewk->wu, projectile->anim_expire, ewk->wu.disp_flag, ewk->wu.hit_stop);
            }
        }

        ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag = 0;
        ewk->wu.hit_quake = 0;
        break;

    case 2:
        switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[2]) {
        case 0:
            add_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
            cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
            /* fallthrough */

        case 1:
            char_move(&ewk->wu);

            if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
                ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
                ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
            }

            break;
        }

        break;
    }
}

static void projectile_process_06000(State_Other* ewk, ProjectileEntity* projectile) {
    PlayerEntity* mwk;
    PlayerEntity* emwk;
    s16 dir;
    s16 emdir;
    s16* target_x;
    s16* target_y;

    mwk = (PlayerEntity*)ewk->my_master;
    emwk = (PlayerEntity*)mwk->wu.target_adrs;
    target_x = &ewk->wu.effect_e3_index;
    target_y = &ewk->wu.effect_e4_index;

    if (ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 1;
    }

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        if (ewk->wu.hit_stop) {
            ewk->wu.hit_stop--;
            break;
        }

        switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[3]) {
        case 0:
            ewk->wu.routine_no[3]++;
            ewk->wu.is_taking_chip_damage = 6;
            ewk->wu.direction = ewk->wu.facing_flag ? projectile->custom_data_1 : 256 - projectile->custom_data_1 & 0xFF;
            effect_I9_init(ewk, 2, 3, 0x77);
            break;

        case 1:
            if (ewk->wu.is_taking_chip_damage--) {
                break;
            }

            ewk->wu.routine_no[3]++;
            ewk->wu.is_taking_chip_damage = 0x70;
            /* fallthrough */

        case 2:
            *target_x = homing_empos_hos[0][ewk->master_player][0];
            *target_x = mwk->wu.facing_flag ? emwk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos - *target_x : emwk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos + *target_x;
            *target_y = homing_empos_hos[0][ewk->master_player][1] + emwk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos;
            dir = ewk->wu.direction;
            emdir = caldir_pos_256(ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos, ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos, *target_x, *target_y);
            dir += (emdir - (dir - 0x80) & 0xFF) > 0x80 ? 4 : -4;
            dir = dir & 0xFF;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = (rate_256_table[dir][0] * 480) / 256;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp *= ewk->wu.facing_flag ? 1 : -1;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp = (rate_256_table[dir][1] * 512) / 256;
            ewk->wu.direction = dir;

            if (ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp < 0) {
                ewk->wu.routine_no[3]++;
            } else if (!ewk->wu.is_taking_chip_damage--) {
                ewk->wu.routine_no[3]++;
            }

            break;
        }

        add_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
        cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
        char_move(&ewk->wu);

        if ((ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos + ewk->wu.cg_jphos) <= 0) {
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[1].sp = 0;
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_expire);
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 1;
            ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = -ewk->wu.cg_jphos;
            return;
        }

        if (--ewk->wu.dir_timer < 0 || screen_range_check(&ewk->wu) != 0) {
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp /= 4;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp /= 4;
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_normal);
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        ewk->wu.vital_new -= ewk->wu.damage_vitality;
        ewk->wu.damage_vitality = 0;

        if (ewk->wu.vital_new < 256) {
            if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player) {
                if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player & 0xF0) {
                    set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_defended);
                } else {
                    set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_hit);
                }
            } else {
                set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_expire);
            }

            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 1;
            ewk->wu.shadow_flag = 0;
            ewk->wu.hit_stop = 0;
        } else {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;

            if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player) {
                if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player & 0xF0) {
                    effect_96_init(&ewk->wu, projectile->anim_defended, ewk->wu.disp_flag, ewk->wu.hit_stop);
                } else {
                    effect_96_init(&ewk->wu, projectile->anim_hit, ewk->wu.disp_flag, ewk->wu.hit_stop);
                }
            } else {
                effect_96_init(&ewk->wu, projectile->anim_expire, ewk->wu.disp_flag, ewk->wu.hit_stop);
            }
        }

        ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag = 0;
        ewk->wu.hit_quake = 0;
        break;

    case 2:
        switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[2]) {
        case 0:
            add_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
            cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
            /* fallthrough */

        case 1:
            char_move(&ewk->wu);

            if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
                ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
                ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
            }

            break;
        }

        break;
    }
}

static void projectile_process_07000(State_Other* ewk, ProjectileEntity* projectile) {
    State* awk;
    s16 dsst;
    PlayerEntity* mwk;
    PlayerEntity* emwk;
    s16 tama_x;

    if (ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 1;
    }

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        if (ewk->wu.hit_stop) {
            ewk->wu.hit_stop--;
            break;
        }

        add_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
        cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
        char_move(&ewk->wu);

        if (g_state.bg_w.stage == 20) {
            ewk->wu.vs_id = 7;
        }

        if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 20) {
            setup_mvxy_data(&ewk->wu, ewk->wu.mvxy.index);
            ewk->wu.mvxy.index++;
            ewk->wu.cg_type = 0;
            mwk = (PlayerEntity*)ewk->my_master;
            emwk = (PlayerEntity*)mwk->wu.target_adrs;
            tama_x = ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos;

            if (tama_x > emwk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos) {
                ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp *= ewk->wu.facing_flag ? -1 : 1;
                ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp *= ewk->wu.facing_flag ? -1 : 1;
            } else {
                ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp *= ewk->wu.facing_flag ? 1 : -1;
                ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp *= ewk->wu.facing_flag ? 1 : -1;
            }
        }

        if (--ewk->wu.dir_timer < 0) {
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_normal);
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        if (ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag == 0) {
            awk = (State*)ewk->wu.dmg_adrs;

            if (awk->work_id == 1) {
                dsst = 3;

                if (!(ewk->wu.damage_attack_type & 0xF8)) {
                    dsst = (ewk->wu.damage_attack_type / 2) & 3;
                }

                ewk->wu.damage_vitality = projectile_process_07_dm_vital[dsst];
            } else {
                ewk->wu.damage_vitality = projectile_process_07_dm_vital[2];
            }
        }

        ewk->wu.vital_new -= ewk->wu.damage_vitality;
        ewk->wu.damage_vitality = 0;

        if (ewk->wu.vital_new < 0x100) {
            if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player) {
                if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player & 0xF0) {
                    set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_defended);
                } else {
                    set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_hit);
                }
            } else {
                set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_expire);
            }

            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 1;
            ewk->wu.shadow_flag = 0;
            ewk->wu.hit_stop = 0;
        } else {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;

            if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player) {
                if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player & 0xF0) {
                    effect_96_init(&ewk->wu, projectile->anim_defended, ewk->wu.disp_flag, ewk->wu.hit_stop);
                } else {
                    effect_96_init(&ewk->wu, projectile->anim_hit, ewk->wu.disp_flag, ewk->wu.hit_stop);
                }
            } else {
                effect_96_init(&ewk->wu, projectile->anim_expire, ewk->wu.disp_flag, ewk->wu.hit_stop);
            }

            if (ewk->damage_reflect) {
                ewk->master_id = (ewk->master_id + 1) & 1;
                ewk->wu.facing_flag = (ewk->wu.facing_flag + 1) & 1;
                ewk->damage_reflect = 0;
            }
        }

        ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag = 0;
        ewk->wu.hit_quake = 0;
        break;

    case 2:
        switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[2]) {
        case 0:
            add_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
            cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
            /* fallthrough */

        case 1:
            char_move(&ewk->wu);

            if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
                ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
                ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
            }

            break;
        }

        break;
    }
}

            /* fallthrough */

        case 1:
            char_move(&ewk->wu);

            if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
                ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
                ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
            }

            break;
        }

        break;
    }
}

static void projectile_process_10000(State_Other* ewk, ProjectileEntity* projectile) {
    char_move(&ewk->wu);

    if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
        return;
    }
}

static void projectile_process_11000(State_Other* ewk, ProjectileEntity* projectile) {
    PlayerEntity* mwk = (PlayerEntity*)ewk->my_master;

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
    case 1:
        if (mwk->sa_stop_flag == 1) {
            break;
        }

        char_move(&ewk->wu);
        add_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
        cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);

        if (ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos <= 0) {
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp = ewk->wu.mvxy.d[1].sp = ewk->wu.mvxy.physics_curve_type[1] = 0;
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_expire);
            ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = 0;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        if (mwk->sa_stop_flag == 1) {
            break;
        }

        char_move(&ewk->wu);
        add_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
        cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);

        if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
        }

        break;
    }

    if (ewk->wu.position_z == ewk->wu.next_z) {
        ewk->wu.position_z = ewk->wu.my_priority;
        return;
    }

    ewk->wu.position_z = ewk->wu.next_z;
}

static void projectile_process_12000(State_Other* ewk, ProjectileEntity* projectile) {
    if (ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 1;
    }

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        if (ewk->wu.hit_stop) {
            if (ewk->wu.hit_stop == 1) {
                ewk->wu.hit_stop = 0;
                add_mvxy_speed_exp(&ewk->wu, 2);
            } else {
                ewk->wu.hit_stop--;
                break;
            }
        } else {
            add_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
        }

        cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
        char_move(&ewk->wu);

        if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 10) {
            add_to_mvxy_data(&ewk->wu, projectile->custom_data_1);
            ewk->wu.cg_type = 0;
            break;
        }

        if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_normal);
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
            break;
        }

        if ((ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos + ewk->wu.cg_jphos) <= 0) {
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[1].sp = 0;
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_expire);
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 1;
            ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = -ewk->wu.cg_jphos;
            break;
        }

        if (--ewk->wu.dir_timer >= 0 && !screen_range_check(&ewk->wu)) {
            break;
        }

        ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp /= 4;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp /= 4;
        set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_normal);
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
        break;

    case 1:
        ewk->wu.vital_new -= ewk->wu.damage_vitality;
        ewk->wu.damage_vitality = 0;

        if (ewk->wu.vital_new < 256) {
            if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player) {
                if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player & 0xF0) {
                    set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_defended);
                } else {
                    set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_hit);
                }
            } else {
                set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_expire);
            }

            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 1;
            ewk->wu.shadow_flag = 0;
            ewk->wu.hit_stop = 0;
        } else {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;

            if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player) {
                if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player & 0xF0) {
                    effect_96_init(&ewk->wu, projectile->anim_defended, ewk->wu.disp_flag, ewk->wu.hit_stop);
                } else {
                    effect_96_init(&ewk->wu, projectile->anim_hit, ewk->wu.disp_flag, ewk->wu.hit_stop);
                }
            } else {
                effect_96_init(&ewk->wu, projectile->anim_expire, ewk->wu.disp_flag, ewk->wu.hit_stop);
            }

            if (ewk->damage_reflect) {
                ewk->master_id = (ewk->master_id + 1) & 1;
                ewk->wu.facing_flag = (ewk->wu.facing_flag + 1) & 1;
                ewk->damage_reflect = 0;
            }
        }

        ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag = 0;
        ewk->wu.hit_quake = 0;
        break;

    case 2:
        switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[2]) {
        case 0:
            add_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
            cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
            /* fallthrough */

        case 1:
            char_move(&ewk->wu);

            if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
                ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
                ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
            }

            break;
        }

        break;
    }
}

static void projectile_process_13000(State_Other* ewk, ProjectileEntity* projectile) {
    PlayerEntity* mwk;
    PlayerEntity* emwk;
    s16 ipos_x;

    if (ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 1;
    }

    mwk = (PlayerEntity*)ewk->my_master;

    if (mwk->wu.routine_no[1] != 4) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
        ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
        return;
    }

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        if (ewk->wu.hit_stop) {
            ewk->wu.hit_stop--;
            break;
        }

        if (!ewk->wu.routine_no[3]) {
            ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = 0;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[3]++;

            if (projectile->custom_data_0) {
                mwk = (PlayerEntity*)ewk->my_master;
                emwk = (PlayerEntity*)mwk->wu.target_adrs;
                ipos_x = enemy_pos_hos[0][emwk->player_number][0];
                ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos =
                    emwk->wu.facing_flag ? emwk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos + ipos_x : emwk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos - ipos_x;
            }
        }

        char_move(&ewk->wu);

        if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_normal);
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
            break;
        }

        if (screen_range_check(&ewk->wu)) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
            break;
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        ewk->wu.vital_new -= ewk->wu.damage_vitality;
        ewk->wu.damage_vitality = 0;

        if (ewk->wu.vital_new < 256) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 1;
            ewk->wu.shadow_flag = 0;
            ewk->wu.hit_stop = 0;
            ewk->wu.att_hit_ok = 0;
        } else {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
        }

        ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag = 0;
        ewk->wu.hit_quake = 0;
        break;

    case 2:
        char_move(&ewk->wu);
        ewk->wu.att_hit_ok = 0;

        if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
        }

        break;
    }
}

static void projectile_process_14000(State_Other* ewk, ProjectileEntity* /* unused */) {
    char_move(&ewk->wu);

    if (ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag) {
        ((State*)ewk->my_master)->hf.hit_flag = ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag;
        ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag = 0;
    }

    if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
        ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
    }
}

static void projectile_process_15000(State_Other* ewk, ProjectileEntity* projectile) {
    if (ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 1;
    }

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        if (ewk->wu.hit_stop) {
            ewk->wu.hit_stop--;
            break;
        }

        add_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
        cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
        char_move(&ewk->wu);

        if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_normal);
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
            break;
        }

        if (--ewk->wu.dir_timer >= 0 && !tama15_screen_check(&ewk->wu)) {
            break;
        }

        ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = 0;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp = 0;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = 0;
        ewk->wu.mvxy.d[1].sp = 0;
        set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_normal);
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
        break;

    case 1:
        ewk->wu.vital_new -= ewk->wu.damage_vitality;
        ewk->wu.damage_vitality = 0;

        if (ewk->wu.vital_new < 256) {
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_normal);
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
        } else {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
        }

        ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag = 0;
        ewk->wu.hit_quake = 0;
        pp_pulpara_hit((State*)ewk->my_master);
        break;

    case 2:
        switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[2]) {
        case 0:
            add_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
            cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
            /* fallthrough */

        case 1:
            char_move(&ewk->wu);

            if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
                ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
                ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
            }

            break;
        }

        break;
    }
}

static void projectile_process_16000(State_Other* ewk, ProjectileEntity* projectile) {
    if (ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag) {
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 1;
    }

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
    case 0:
        if (ewk->wu.hit_stop) {
            if (ewk->wu.hit_stop == 1) {
                ewk->wu.hit_stop = 0;
            } else {
                ewk->wu.hit_stop--;
                break;
            }
        } else {
            add_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);

            if (ewk->wu.facing_flag) {
                ewk->wu.xyz[0].cal += 0x38000;
            } else {
                ewk->wu.xyz[0].cal += -0x38000;
            }
        }

        cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
        char_move(&ewk->wu);

        if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_normal);
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
            break;
        }

        if ((ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos + ewk->wu.cg_jphos) <= 0) {
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[0].sp = 0;
            ewk->wu.mvxy.d[1].sp = 0;
            set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_expire);
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 1;
            ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = -ewk->wu.cg_jphos;
            break;
        }

        if (--ewk->wu.dir_timer >= 0 && !screen_range_check(&ewk->wu)) {
            break;
        }

        set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_normal);
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
        break;

    case 1:
        ewk->wu.vital_new -= ewk->wu.damage_vitality;
        ewk->wu.damage_vitality = 0;

        if (ewk->wu.vital_new < 256) {
            if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player) {
                if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player & 0xF0) {
                    set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_defended);
                } else {
                    set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_hit);
                }
            } else {
                set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, projectile->anim_expire);
            }

            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 1;
            ewk->wu.shadow_flag = 0;
            ewk->wu.hit_stop = 0;
        } else {
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;

            if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player) {
                if (ewk->wu.hf.hit.player & 0xF0) {
                    effect_96_init(&ewk->wu, projectile->anim_defended, ewk->wu.disp_flag, ewk->wu.hit_stop);
                } else {
                    effect_96_init(&ewk->wu, projectile->anim_hit, ewk->wu.disp_flag, ewk->wu.hit_stop);
                }
            } else {
                effect_96_init(&ewk->wu, projectile->anim_expire, ewk->wu.disp_flag, ewk->wu.hit_stop);
            }

            if (ewk->damage_reflect) {
                ewk->master_id = (ewk->master_id + 1) & 1;
                ewk->wu.facing_flag = (ewk->wu.facing_flag + 1) & 1;
                ewk->damage_reflect = 0;
            }
        }

        ewk->wu.hf.hit_flag = 0;
        ewk->wu.hit_quake = 0;
        break;

    case 2:
        switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[2]) {
        case 0:
            add_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
            cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
            /* fallthrough */

        case 1:
            char_move(&ewk->wu);

            if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
                ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
                ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
            }

            break;
        }

        break;
    }
}

s32 effect_13_init(State* wk, u8 data) {
    State_Other* ewk;
    s16 ix;

    if ((ix = Acquire_Effect(3)) == -1) {
        return -1;
    }

    ewk = (State_Other*)frw[ix];
    write_my_shell_ix(wk, ix);

    if (wk->work_id == 1 && wk->facing_flag == 1 && ((PlayerEntity*)wk)->player_number == 0) {
        data++;
    }

    ewk->wu.active_flag = 1;
    ewk->wu.id = 13;
    ewk->wu.type = data;
    ewk->wu.pl_operator = wk->pl_operator;
    ewk->wu.facing_flag = wk->facing_flag;
    ewk->wu.my_family = wk->my_family;
    ewk->wu.graphic_rom_type = wk->graphic_rom_type;
    ewk->wu.my_col_mode = wk->my_col_mode;
    ewk->wu.old_routine_no[7] = wk->my_col_code;
    ewk->wu.weight_level = wk->weight_level;
    ewk->wu.active_move = g_state.Round_num;
    ewk->my_master = wk;

    if (wk->work_id == 1) {
        ewk->master_player = ((PlayerEntity*)wk)->player_number;
        ewk->master_id = wk->id;
        ewk->master_work_id = wk->work_id;
        ewk->wu.olc_work_ix[0] = ((PlayerEntity*)wk)->strike_scaling;
        ewk->wu.olc_work_ix[1] = ((PlayerEntity*)wk)->throw_scaling;
        ewk->wu.olc_work_ix[2] = ((PlayerEntity*)wk)->stun_scaling;
        ewk->wu.olc_work_ix[3] = wk->routine_no[1];
    } else {
        ewk->master_player = ((State_Other*)wk)->master_player;
        ewk->master_id = ((State_Other*)wk)->master_id;
        ewk->master_work_id = ((State_Other*)wk)->master_work_id;
    }

    ewk->wu.xyz[0] = wk->xyz[0];
    ewk->wu.xyz[1] = wk->xyz[1];
    ewk->wu.my_effadrs = &projectile_data[data];

    if (wk->work_id == 1) {
        ewk->wu.floor = ((PlayerEntity*)wk)->metamorphose;
    }

    return 0;
}

const s16 panel_pos_offset[8][4][2] = {
    { { 25, 99 }, { 25, 100 }, { 0, 0 }, { 25, 100 } }, { { 43, 103 }, { 42, 106 }, { 0, 0 }, { 42, 106 } },
    { { 18, 115 }, { 0, 0 }, { 0, 0 }, { 18, 115 } },   { { 18, 115 }, { 0, 0 }, { 0, 0 }, { 18, 115 } },

    { { -23, 112 }, { 0, 0 }, { 0, 0 }, { -23, 112 } }, { { -86, 60 }, { 0, 0 }, { 0, 0 }, { -86, 60 } }
};

void effect_37_move(State_Other* ewk) {
    State* mwk = (State*)ewk->my_master;
    s16 ix;

    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[0]) {
    case 0:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
        ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
        ewk->wu.my_col_mode = 0x4200;
        ewk->wu.my_col_code = (ewk->wu.type == 1) + 0x28;
        set_char_move_init2(&ewk->wu, 0, 0, g_state.plw[ewk->wu.type].player_number + 1, 0);

        if (g_state.plw[0].player_number == g_state.plw[1].player_number) {
            effect_H2_init(&ewk->wu, ewk->wu.charset_id, ewk->wu.type);
            break;
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        if (ewk->wu.death_timer == 1) {
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
            break;
        }

        if (mwk->cg_type) {
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;

            if (mwk->cg_type == 0xFF) {
                ix = 3;
            } else {
                ix = mwk->cg_type - 1;
            }

            if (ewk->wu.active_move) {
                ewk->wu.position_x = mwk->position_x - panel_pos_offset[ewk->wu.charset_id][ix][0];
            } else {
                ewk->wu.position_x = mwk->position_x + panel_pos_offset[ewk->wu.charset_id][ix][0];
            }

            ewk->wu.position_y = mwk->position_y + panel_pos_offset[ewk->wu.charset_id][ix][1];
        } else {
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
        }

        sort_push_request(&ewk->wu);
        break;

    case 2:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 3;
        break;

    default:
        Release_Effect(&ewk->wu);
        break;
    }
}

s32 effect_37_init(State* wk, u8 gal, u8 ohen) {
    State_Other* ewk;
    s16 ix;

    if ((ix = Acquire_Effect(4)) == -1) {
        return -1;
    }

    ewk = (State_Other*)frw[ix];
    ewk->wu.active_flag = 1;
    ewk->wu.id = 37;
    ewk->wu.work_id = 16;
    ewk->wu.charset_id = gal;
    ewk->wu.type = ohen;
    ewk->my_master = wk;
    ewk->wu.active_move = wk->facing_flag;
    ewk->wu.graphic_rom_type = 1;
    ewk->wu.my_family = 2;
    ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet = 14;
    ewk->wu.position_z = wk->position_z - 1;
    ewk->wu.char_table[0] = _ag_face_panel_table;
    return 0;
}

void effect_C2_move(State_Other* ewk) {
    switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[0]) {
    case 0:
        ewk->wu.routine_no[0]++;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[3] = 2;
        g_state.Bonus_Game_result = 0;
        ewk->wu.charset_id = 17;
        set_char_base_data(&ewk->wu);
        ewk->wu.vital_new = ewk->master_id == 0;
        setup_prio_ix(ewk);
        get_bs2_parts_data(&ewk->wu);
        setup_vital_bonus2(&ewk->wu);
        ewk->wu.position_x = ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos;
        ewk->wu.position_y = ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos;
        ewk->wu.cg_number = 9;
        effect_C3_init(ewk, 3);
        effect_C3_init(ewk, 4);
        effect_C3_init(ewk, 5);
        effect_C3_init(ewk, 6);
        effect_C3_init(ewk, 7);
        effect_C3_init(ewk, 1);
        effect_C3_init(ewk, 2);
        effect_00_init(&ewk->wu);
        clear_attack_num(&ewk->wu);
        ewk->wu.dir_old = 0;
        ewk->wu.direction = 0;
        ewk->wu.dir_timer = 0;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
        ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
        effect_J9_init(ewk, 8);
        break;

    case 1:
        if (ewk->wu.death_timer == 1) {
            ewk->wu.disp_flag = 0;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
            ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 10;
            ewk->wu.hit_stop = 0;
            break;
        }

        if (ewk->wu.dir_timer) {
            effC2_main_process_second(ewk, (PlayerEntity*)ewk->wu.target_adrs);
        } else {
            effC2_main_process_first(ewk, (PlayerEntity*)ewk->wu.target_adrs);
        }

        set_bs2_floor(ewk);
        break;

    case 2:
        if (g_state.execute_flag == 0 && g_state.Game_pause == 0) {
            switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
            case 0:
                if (--ewk->wu.hit_stop > 0) {
                    break;
                }

                ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 9;
                ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
                g_state.Bonus_Game_result |= 2;
                ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = 80;
                ewk->wu.next_y = 64;
                ewk->wu.position_z = 25;
                illegal_setup_effK2(&ewk->wu, 4);
                c2_last_char_and_mvxy(ewk);
                setup_demojump((PlayerEntity*)ewk->wu.target_adrs, 2);
                break;

            case 9:
                switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[2]) {
                case 0:
                    char_move(&ewk->wu);
                    add_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
                    cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);

                    if (ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp <= 0 && (ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos <= ewk->wu.next_y)) {
                        ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = ewk->wu.next_y;
                        ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 1;
                        char_move_cmja(&ewk->wu);
                    }

                    break;

                case 1:
                    char_move(&ewk->wu);

                    switch (ewk->wu.cg_type) {
                    case 1:
                        if (ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp > 0) {
                            add_mvxy_speed_direct(&ewk->wu, 128, 0);
                        } else {
                            add_mvxy_speed_direct(&ewk->wu, -128, 0);
                        }

                        break;

                    case 2:
                        if (ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp > 0) {
                            add_mvxy_speed_direct(&ewk->wu, 256, 0);
                        } else {
                            add_mvxy_speed_direct(&ewk->wu, -256, 0);
                        }

                        break;

                    case 0xFF:
                        ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 2;
                        break;
                    }

                    break;
                }

                break;

            default:
                ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 3;
                ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
                break;
            }

            ewk->wu.next_x = 0;
            set_c2_quake(&ewk->wu);
        }

        ewk->wu.position_x = ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos + ewk->wu.next_x;
        ewk->wu.position_y = ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos;
        sort_push_request(&ewk->wu);
        break;

    default:
        Release_Effect(&ewk->wu);
        break;
    }
}

static void effC2_main_process_first(State_Other* ewk, PlayerEntity* twk) {
    if (g_state.execute_flag == 0 && g_state.Game_pause == 0) {
        switch (ewk->wu.direction + (twk->bs2_on_car * 2)) {
        case 0:
            if (ewk->wu.routine_no[1] != 1 && ewk->wu.routine_no[2] != 0) {
                ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
                ewk->wu.routine_no[3] = 2;
            }

            break;

        case 3:
            if (ewk->wu.routine_no[1] != 1 && ewk->wu.routine_no[2] != 1) {
                ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 1;
                ewk->wu.routine_no[3] = 2;
            }

            break;

        case 1:
            if (ewk->wu.routine_no[1] != 1 || ewk->wu.routine_no[2] != 0) {
                ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
                ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
                ewk->wu.routine_no[3] = 0;
            }

            break;

        case 2:
            if (ewk->wu.routine_no[1] != 1 || ewk->wu.routine_no[2] != 0) {
                ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
                ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 1;
                ewk->wu.routine_no[3] = 0;
            }

            break;
        }

        ewk->wu.old_pos[0] = ewk->wu.old_pos[1] = 0;

        switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
        case 0:
            switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[2]) {
            case 0:
                switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[3]) {
                case 0:
                    ewk->wu.routine_no[3]++;
                    set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, 76);
                    break;

                case 1:
                    char_move(&ewk->wu);

                    if (ewk->wu.cg_type != 0xFF) {
                        break;
                    }

                    ewk->wu.routine_no[3]++;
                    /* fallthrough */

                default:
                    ewk->wu.cg_type = 0;
                    ewk->wu.cg_number = 9;
                    break;
                }

                break;

            default:
                switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[3]) {
                case 0:
                    ewk->wu.routine_no[3]++;
                    set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, 77);
                    break;

                case 1:
                    char_move(&ewk->wu);

                    if (ewk->wu.cg_type != 0xFF) {
                        break;
                    }

                    ewk->wu.routine_no[3]++;
                    /* fallthrough */

                default:
                    ewk->wu.cg_type = 0;
                    ewk->wu.cg_number = 18;
                    break;
                }
            }

            ewk->wu.old_pos[0] = ewk->wu.cg_type;
            ewk->wu.cg_type = 0;
            break;

        case 1:
            switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[2]) {
            case 0:
                ewk->wu.shell_ix[0] -= ewk->wu.damage_vitality;
                ewk->wu.damage_vitality = 0;

                if (twk->bs2_on_car) {
                    ewk->wu.hit_stop = 0;
                } else {
                    ewk->wu.hit_stop = ewk->wu.damage_hit_stop / 2;
                }

                ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 1;
                set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu,
                                   0,
                                   (twk->bs2_on_car * 6) +
                                       ((ewk->wu.damage_facing == 0) + sel_dm_quake[ewk->wu.damage_attack_level][ewk->wu.active_move]));

                if (ewk->wu.shell_ix[0] < 0) {
                    ewk->wu.dir_old = 1;
                    ewk->wu.dir_timer = 1;
                    ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
                    ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 9;
                    break;
                }

                check_parts_break_level(&ewk->wu);
                /* fallthrough */

            case 1:
                if (--ewk->wu.hit_stop <= 0) {
                    char_move(&ewk->wu);

                    if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
                        ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
                        ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
                        ewk->wu.cg_type = 0;
                    }
                }

                break;
            }

            ewk->wu.old_pos[1] = ewk->wu.cg_type;
            ewk->wu.cg_type = 0;
            break;
        }
    }

    player_modifier_data(ewk, ewk->wu.dir_timer, 1);
    setup_parts_break(&ewk->wu);
    setup_prio_ix(ewk);
    send_to_shizumi_guai(&ewk->wu);
    ewk->wu.direction = twk->bs2_on_car;
    copy_rno(&ewk->wu);

    if (!ewk->wu.dir_timer) {
        effc2_parts_work_chain_check(ewk->wu.vital_new);
    }
}

static void effc2_parts_work_chain_check(s16 flag) {
    State* adr0;
    State* adr1;
    State* adr2;
    State* adr3;
    s16 wix = search_effect_index(1, 0, 0x7B);
    s16 bf[4];
    s16 bh[4];

    if (wix == -1) {
        return;
    }

    while (wix != -1) {
        adr1 = (State*)frw[wix];

        if (adr1->type == 4 || adr1->type == 5) {
            goto jump;
        }

        wix = adr1->behind;
    }

    return;

jump:
    if (flag) {
        if (adr1->type == 4) {
            return;
        }
    } else if (adr1->type == 5) {
        return;
    }

    if (adr1->behind == -1) {
        return;
    }

    adr2 = (State*)frw[adr1->behind];

    if (flag) {
        if (adr2->type != 4) {
            return;
        }
    } else if (adr2->type != 5) {
        return;
    }

    adr0 = (State*)frw[adr1->before];
    adr3 = (State*)frw[adr2->behind];
    bf[1] = adr1->before;
    bf[2] = adr2->before;
    bf[3] = adr3->before;
    bh[0] = adr0->behind;
    bh[1] = adr1->behind;
    bh[2] = adr2->behind;
    adr0->behind = bh[1];
    adr1->behind = bh[2];
    adr2->behind = bh[0];
    adr1->before = bf[3];
    adr2->before = bf[1];
    adr3->before = bf[2];
}

static void effC2_main_process_second(State_Other* ewk, PlayerEntity* twk) {
    if (g_state.execute_flag == 0 && g_state.Game_pause == 0) {
        switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[1]) {
        case 0:
            switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[2]) {
            case 0:
                break;

            case 9:
                if (ewk->wu.hit_stop == 0) {
                    illegal_setup_effK2(&ewk->wu, 0);
                }

                if (--ewk->wu.hit_stop < 0) {
                    g_state.Time_Stop = 1;
                    setup_demojump(twk, 0);
                    ewk->wu.routine_no[2]++;
                    ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp = 0x20000;
                    ewk->wu.mvxy.d[1].sp = -0x8000;
                    ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos = 64;
                    set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, 71);
                    ewk->wu.disp_flag = 1;
                    bs2_score_add_next(&ewk->wu);
                    set_1st_Bonus_Game_result(&ewk->wu);
                }

                break;

            case 10:
                add_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);
                cal_mvxy_speed(&ewk->wu);

                if (ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos <= 0) {
                    ewk->wu.routine_no[2]++;
                    ewk->wu.position_y = 0;
                    ewk->wu.xyz[1].cal = 0;
                    ewk->wu.mvxy.a[1].sp = 0;
                    reset_mvxy_data(&ewk->wu);
                    char_move_z(&ewk->wu);
                    illegal_setup_effK2(&ewk->wu, 1);
                }

                break;

            case 11:
                char_move(&ewk->wu);

                switch (ewk->wu.cg_type) {
                case 2:
                    illegal_setup_effK2(&ewk->wu, 2);
                    ewk->wu.cg_type = 0;
                    break;

                case 3:
                    illegal_setup_effK2(&ewk->wu, 3);
                    ewk->wu.cg_type = 0;
                    break;
                }

                if (ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
                    set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, 70);
                    ewk->wu.dir_old = 0;
                    ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
                    ewk->wu.original_vitality = ewk->wu.shell_ix[0] = 0x640;
                    ewk->wu.vital_old = 0;
                    g_state.Time_Stop = 0;
                }

                break;
            }

            break;

        case 1:
            switch (ewk->wu.routine_no[2]) {
            case 0:
                if (g_state.Time_Over) {
                    ewk->wu.damage_vitality = 0;
                }

                ewk->wu.shell_ix[0] -= ewk->wu.damage_vitality;
                ewk->wu.damage_vitality = 0;
                ewk->wu.hit_stop = ewk->wu.damage_hit_stop;

                if (ewk->wu.hit_stop < 0) {
                    ewk->wu.hit_stop = -ewk->wu.hit_stop;
                }

                ewk->wu.hit_stop /= 2;
                ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 1;
                setup_parts_break2(&ewk->wu);

                if (check_parts_break_level(&ewk->wu) != 0) {
                    char_move_z(&ewk->wu);
                    setup_effK2(&ewk->wu);
                }

                setup_effK4(&ewk->wu);

                if (ewk->wu.shell_ix[0] < 0 || ewk->wu.cg_type == 0xFF) {
                    ewk->wu.dir_old = 1;
                    ewk->wu.routine_no[0] = 2;
                    ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
                    ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
                    ewk->wu.cg_type = 0;
                    g_state.Time_Stop = 1;
                }

                break;

            case 1:
                if (--ewk->wu.hit_stop <= 0) {
                    ewk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
                    ewk->wu.routine_no[2] = 0;
                }

                break;
            }

            break;
        }

        if (ewk->wu.dir_old == 0) {
            hit_push_request(&ewk->wu);
        }

        ewk->wu.next_x = 0;
        set_c2_quake(&ewk->wu);
    }

    setup_prio_ix(ewk);
    set_parts_priority(&ewk->wu);
    player_modifier_data(ewk, ewk->wu.dir_timer, 1);
    ewk->wu.position_x = ewk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos + ewk->wu.next_x;
    ewk->wu.position_y = ewk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos;
    sort_push_request(&ewk->wu);
}

static void c2_last_char_and_mvxy(State_Other* ewk) {
    s16 ix = c2_last_dir_select((PlayerEntity*)ewk->wu.target_adrs, &ewk->wu);

    set_char_move_init(&ewk->wu, 0, ewk->wu.damage_attack_level + 92 + ix);
    setup_move_data_easy(&ewk->wu, c2_last_bomb[ewk->wu.damage_attack_level], 1, 0);

    if (ix) {
        ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp = -ewk->wu.mvxy.a[0].sp;
    }
}

static s16 c2_last_dir_select(PlayerEntity* wk, State* efw) {
    s16 ix = get_sel_adjust_tbl_ix(wk->player_number) + 1;
    s16* dad = efw->adjust_adrs[ix].hos_box;

    ix = 4;

    if (check_work_position_bonus(&wk->wu, dad[0] + (dad[1] / 2) + efw->xyz[0].disp.pos)) {
        ix = 0;
    }

    return ix;
}

void setup_demojump(PlayerEntity* twk, s16 ix) {
    switch (ix) {
    case 0:
        if (twk->wu.xyz[1].disp.pos > 3) {
            twk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
            twk->wu.routine_no[2] = 56;
            twk->wu.routine_no[3] = 0;
        }

        break;

    case 1:
        if (twk->bs2_on_car) {
            twk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
            twk->wu.routine_no[2] = 58;
            twk->wu.routine_no[3] = 0;
        }

        break;

    case 2:
        if ((twk->wu.pat_status >= 14 && twk->wu.pat_status <= 30) || twk->bs2_on_car) {
            twk->wu.routine_no[1] = 0;
            twk->wu.routine_no[2] = 56;
            twk->wu.routine_no[3] = 0;
        }

        break;
    }

    if (twk->wu.hit_stop) {
        twk->wu.hit_stop /= 2;

        if (twk->wu.hit_stop == 0) {
            twk->wu.hit_stop = 1;
        }
    }
}

s32 check_effc2_p2_rno(State* wk) {
    State* c2wk = (State*)wk->my_effadrs;

    if (c2wk->dir_timer == 0) {
        return 0;
    }

    if (c2wk->routine_no[1] != 0 || c2wk->routine_no[2] != 10) {
        return 0;
    }

    return 1;
}

static void copy_rno(State* wk) {
    wk->old_routine_no[0] = wk->routine_no[0];
    wk->old_routine_no[1] = wk->routine_no[1];
    wk->old_routine_no[2] = wk->routine_no[2];
    wk->old_routine_no[3] = wk->routine_no[3];
}

void player_modifier_data(State_Other* ewk, s16 flag, s16 f2) {
    if (f2) {
        if (ewk->wu.type) {
            ewk->wu.cg_ja.pushbox_index = get_sel_adjust_tbl_ix(ewk->master_player) + 1 + ((flag == 1) * 2);
            ewk->wu.pushbox = &ewk->wu.adjust_adrs[ewk->wu.cg_ja.pushbox_index];
        } else {
            ewk->wu.cg_ja.pushbox_index = get_sel_adjust_tbl_ix(ewk->master_player) + ((flag == 1) * 2);
            ewk->wu.pushbox = &ewk->wu.adjust_adrs[ewk->wu.cg_ja.pushbox_index];
        }
    } else {
        ewk->wu.cg_ja.pushbox_index = 0;
        ewk->wu.pushbox = &ewk->wu.adjust_adrs[ewk->wu.cg_ja.pushbox_index];
    }
}

static void set_c2_quake(State* wk) {
    if (!wk->hit_stop) {
        return;
    }

    if (wk->hit_stop & 1) {
        wk->next_x = -1;
    }

    if (wk->hit_stop > 6) {
        wk->next_x *= 2;
    }

    if (wk->damage_facing) {
        wk->next_x = -wk->next_x;
    }
}

void get_bs2_parts_data(State* wk) {
    const BS2* bs2 = &bs2_data_table[wk->type];

    wk->work_id = 2;
    wk->dir_timer = bs2->dir_timer;
    wk->dir_step = bs2->chix;
    wk->my_col_code = bs2->color;
    wk->xyz[0].disp.pos = 448;
    wk->xyz[1].disp.pos = 0;
    wk->my_priority = bs2->prio_low;
    wk->vital_old = 0;
    wk->damage_calc_multiplier = 1;
    wk->damage_calc_divider = 2;
    wk->damage_vitality = 0;
    wk->dir_atthit = -1;
    wk->vs_id = -1;
    set_parts_priority(wk);
}

static void setup_prio_ix(State_Other* c2wk) {
    PlayerEntity* mwk = (PlayerEntity*)c2wk->my_master;
    PlayerEntity* twk = (PlayerEntity*)mwk->wu.target_adrs;

    c2wk->wu.vital_new = 0;

    if (twk->bs2_on_car || twk->bs2_over_car2 || mwk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos < twk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos) {
        c2wk->wu.vital_new = 1;
    }
}

void set_parts_priority(State* wk) {
    const BS2* bs2 = &bs2_data_table[wk->type];
    State* c2wk = (State*)wk->my_effadrs;

    if (c2wk->vital_new) {
        wk->my_priority = bs2->prio_low;
    } else {
        wk->my_priority = bs2->prio_hi;
    }

    wk->position_z = wk->my_priority;
}

static void setup_vital_bonus2(State* wk) {
    s16 i;

    for (i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        wk->shell_ix[i] = bs2_data_table[i].vital;
        wk->script_register_bank[i] = 0;
    }
}

void c3_new_damage(State* wk) {
    State* c2wk;
    s16 ix;
    s16 brlv;

    if (g_state.Time_Over) {
        wk->damage_vitality = 0;
    }

    c2wk = (State*)wk->my_effadrs;
    c2wk->routine_no[1] = 1;
    c2wk->routine_no[2] = 0;
    c2wk->damage_attack_level = wk->damage_attack_level;
    c2wk->damage_facing = wk->damage_facing;
    c2wk->damage_direction = wk->damage_direction;
    c2wk->damage_hit_stop = wk->damage_hit_stop;
    c2wk->active_move = wk->type;

    if (c2wk->damage_hit_stop < 0) {
        c2wk->damage_hit_stop = -c2wk->damage_hit_stop;
    }

    wk->damage_vitality = (wk->damage_vitality * wk->damage_calc_multiplier) / wk->damage_calc_divider;
    ix = ix_exchange[wk->type];
    brlv = dm_copy_to_master[wk->type];
    c2wk->shell_ix[ix] -= wk->damage_vitality;

    if (c2wk->shell_ix[ix] <= 0) {
        c2wk->damage_vitality += wk->damage_vitality;
        c2wk->shell_ix[ix] = 0;
    } else if (c2wk->script_register_bank[ix] >= brlv) {
        c2wk->damage_vitality += wk->damage_vitality / 2;
    }

    wk->damage_vitality = 0;
    g_state.bs2_current_damage = wk->type;
}

s16 c3_hit_disp_check(u8 ix) {
    return bs2_data_table[ix].vital;
}

s16 bs2_sync_bomb(State* wk) {
    return ((State*)wk->my_effadrs)->dir_old;
}

void bs2_get_parts_break(State* wk) {
    wk->screen_move_x = ((State*)wk->my_effadrs)->cg_number;
    wk->screen_move_y = ((State*)wk->my_effadrs)->script_register_bank[wk->type];
}

static void setup_parts_break(State* wk) {
    s32 vint;
    s16 i;
    s16 j;
    s16 ix;

    for (i = 0; i < 8; i++) {
        ix = ix_exchange[i];
        vint = bs2_data_table[ix].vital;

        for (j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
            if (wk->shell_ix[ix] > (vint * pbl_select[ix][j]) / 100) {
                break;
            }
        }

        wk->script_register_bank[i] = j;
    }
}

static void setup_parts_break2(State* wk) {
    s32 vint = wk->original_vitality;
    s16 j;

    for (j = 0; j < 7; j++) {
        if (wk->shell_ix[0] > (vint * pbl_select[0][j]) / 100) {
            break;
        }
    }

    wk->script_register_bank[0] = j;
}

s32 check_parts_break_level(State* wk) {
    State* c2wk = (State*)wk->my_effadrs;
    s16 i;

    if (wk->vital_old == c2wk->script_register_bank[wk->type]) {
        return 0;
    }

    if ((wk->id != 0x7A || c2wk->dir_timer != 0) && wk->vital_old < c2wk->script_register_bank[wk->type]) {
        for (i = wk->vital_old; i < c2wk->script_register_bank[wk->type]; i++) {
            additional_score_damage((State_Other*)wk->target_adrs, pbs_table[wk->type][i]);
        }
    }

    wk->vital_old = c2wk->script_register_bank[wk->type];
    return 1;
}

static void bs2_score_add_next(State* wk) {
    s16 i;

    for (i = 1; i < 8; i++) {
        additional_score_damage((State_Other*)wk->target_adrs, pbs_table[i][wk->script_register_bank[i]]);
    }
}

static void set_1st_Bonus_Game_result(State* wk) {
    s16 i;
    s16 num = 0;

    for (i = 1; i < 8; i++) {
        num += wk->script_register_bank[i];
    }

    if (num == 49) {
        g_state.Bonus_Game_result = 1;
    }
}

static void set_bs2_floor(State_Other* wk) {
    s16* dad;

    player_modifier_data(wk, wk->wu.dir_timer, 1);
    dad = wk->wu.adjust_adrs[wk->wu.cg_ja.pushbox_index].hos_box;
    g_state.bs2_floor[0] = wk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos + dad[0];
    g_state.bs2_floor[1] = wk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos + dad[0] + dad[1];
    g_state.bs2_floor[2] = dad[2] + dad[3];
    dad = wk->wu.adjust_adrs[wk->wu.cg_ja.pushbox_index + 1].hos_box;
    g_state.bonus_stage2_offset[0] = wk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos + dad[0];
    g_state.bonus_stage2_offset[1] = wk->wu.xyz[0].disp.pos + dad[0] + dad[1];
    g_state.bonus_stage2_offset[2] = dad[2] + dad[3];
}

void get_shizumi_guai(State* wk) {
    wk->next_x = shindou_guai[((State*)wk->my_effadrs)->old_pos[1]][wk->type];
    wk->next_y = shizumi_guai[((State*)wk->my_effadrs)->old_pos[0]][wk->type];
}

static void send_to_shizumi_guai(State* wk) {
    ((State*)wk->target_adrs)->next_y = shizumi_guai[((State*)wk->my_effadrs)->old_pos[0]][0];
}

s32 effect_C2_init(State* wk, u8 data) {
    State_Other* ewk;
    s16 ix;

    if ((ix = Acquire_Effect(1)) == -1) {
        return -1;
    }

    ewk = (State_Other*)frw[ix];
    ewk->wu.active_flag = 1;
    ewk->wu.id = 0x7A;
    ewk->wu.type = data;
    ewk->wu.my_sprite_sheet = 5;
    ewk->my_master = wk;
    ewk->wu.target_adrs = wk->target_adrs;
    ewk->master_player = ((PlayerEntity*)wk)->player_number;
    ewk->master_id = wk->id;
    ewk->master_work_id = wk->work_id;
    wk->my_effadrs = ewk;
    ewk->wu.my_effadrs = ewk;
    effect_C2_move(ewk);
    return 0;
}

/**

#include "sf33rd/Source/Game/effect/effect_c9_sound_judge_shadow.h"

                                    { { 2, 0, 1, 0 }, { 6, 5, 3, 0 }, { 4, 0, 1, 0 }, { 3, 2, 5, 0 } },
